excerpt: The Climate Data Journalism Workshop | Bengaluru Edition Inviting journalists and media fraternity to attend a 2‑day certificate course on India’s Climate Change. A 2‑day certificate course that aims to provide journalists with the basic tools and skill-sets to report on climate change. Who can attend Journalists and reporters with minimum 3 years of work experience in the newsroom across beats. Registration fee INR 800/- + GST (The payment link will be sent to you after registration) Contact details Contact earthcheckworkshops@indiaspend.org for any enquiries.
